title: Automated code migration: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Rector rewrites the PHP, Fractor the TypoScript, Fluid and FlexForms, and one change rolls out to many extensions in reviewable batches. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 90 seconds: Automated code migration, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-extension-upgrade, typo3-rector, typo3-fractor, typo3-batch). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: Forty extensions, one deprecated API, and nobody wants to fix it by hand.
Automated code migration: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Makes one extension work with a newer TYPO3 LTS, with Extension Scanner, Rector, Fractor and PHPStan.
It treats a failing commit hook as a check to fix, not an obstacle to skip.
Fixes deprecated PHP calls with Rector: dry run, review the diff, apply, dry run again.
Apply, dry-run again: one generated file left. Once more: Rector is done.
Rewrites TypoScript, FlexForms, Fluid, YAML and XLIFF towards v14 with Fractor.
FlexForm, TypoScript and Fluid patterns are easy to miss in a review.
Applies one repeated change to many extensions at once, in reviewable batches.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
